scope: Only add penalty-and-repair to the three manuscript time-convergence panels.
timing_decision_stage: Specified during public calibration, before penalty test results were collected.
plot_time: Recorded elapsed time minus all intermediate repaired-point diagnostic-adjoint durations, plus one repaired-point adjoint duration for the current returned candidate when needed. Exact cached candidate evaluations reuse their recorded duration. Raw optimization adjoints, Adam updates, repair and inexpensive diagnostics remain included.
reason: Do not attribute repeated instrumentation-only stationarity evaluations to the intrinsic penalty solver; retain the cost of evaluating its final feasible candidate.
preservation: Keep unadjusted elapsed time, all monitoring durations and all oracle counts in the raw results; do not rerun or alter PB-AMD or PGD.
curves: Median and interquartile range over every one of the same ten seeds in each panel. No failures are removed.
